name: flaggems_lcm
description: Element-wise least common multiple (torch.lcm) over integer tensors. Correctness inputs are constrained to [1, 100) matching the FlagGems correctness pytest (torch.randint(1,100)); dtypes int16/int32 come from tests INT_DTYPES. Timing uses generic full-range integer random inputs from BinaryPointwiseBenchmark.
